rootCause: Historical static records were retained after source IA/roster bytes changed and after two legacy operations consumers ceased to exist; treating archival records as current conformance would either create fake consumers or bypass actual consumer review.
finiteDenominator: P6-2: 38 screen IDs / 36 present platform consumers
P6-3: 58 archival records less 2 absent zero-reference legacy paths = 56 present controls
counterexamples: P6-2 has no missing consumer or route mount
P6-3 present controls already have feature-owned test grouping; per-component test-file identity is not the test denominator
P6-3 absent brand/tenant legacy paths cannot be passed
minimalReusableFix: Rebase only the present physical denominator against current source hashes and explicit feature-owned focused tests; preserve absent paths as excluded evidence and gate L2 on the rebased records.

prevention.evidence: record distinguishes present PASS from excluded legacy path and static proof from L2
